quest.title: Within the Depths of Erinnyes
quest.description: You finally have all three Waterdrop keys. According to Pahsiv, these are key to stopping Erinnyes from "Melusine-ing."

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Key, statue, key, statue, key, statue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you mean... that we need to put the keys in the statues? Well, that sounds about right. Three keys, three statues...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shall we give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happens after we place the keys?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Door opens, open door...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Door? Where? And what's behind the door?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Root, Erinnyes, very deep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A door to the root of Erinnyes? You know so much, Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, protect!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What else do we have to know?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know, like information! The more the merrier! The more we know, the more confident we will be!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: In...formation? In...formation... Pahsiv! Information, a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Erinnyes, information, lots of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lots of information, uh huh.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Information, water vein, lots of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lots of water veins, right.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Water vein, New Valet, lots of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Hmm? New Valet? Lots of? Wait, Paimon doesn't get it. Where do all these valets come from? Or are you telling Paimon that this New Valet knows how to create mirror images of themselves?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Melusine!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Water vein, New Valet, taste.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Evil, New Valet, sense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tasting the evil in the water vein? Err, what kind of flavor is that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New Valet can sense information through the water veins?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Willow, collect. Fog, handle. Spring, send.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Root, water vein, center.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, Erinnyes is the center of information?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you saying that all of Erinnyes is New Valet's information system? And New Valet can sense something bad?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Smart Paimon! Smart {NICKNAME}! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gosh, who is this New Valet?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Fontaine, New Valet, protect.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: But, New Valet, very busy.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, sneaking toward the root. Purple thing, secretly destroying the root.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, peek. Pahsiv, secretly scratch the stone tablet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're the one that removed the writing from the stone tablet! Was it to stop the purple thing?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! But...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, kept going toward the root. Purple thing, very powerful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The purple thing found another way?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like this purple thing's a tough customer. If the root is destroyed, then the information system will fail to function, and New Valet's senses will be affected.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, duty! Pahsiv, protect!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, ka-pow. Paimon, ka-pow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, we can't wait anymore. We need to ka-pow now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright then, Pahsiv! Open the door!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excellent. Let's go!

talks.objective: Insert the Waterdrop Keys into the statue
Insert the Waterdrop Keys into the statue
Insert the Waterdrop Keys into the statue

dialogues.speaker: Keratry
dialogues.text: Brother! Look! There seems to be a hole in the fountain. Was that your magic?

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: ...Uh... Yes, that's right! That was your brother's magic, indeed. Awesome, right?

dialogues.speaker: Keratry
dialogues.text: Yup! I didn't think you'd have a trick that's as good as the Great Magician Lyney's!

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: Ahem...

talks.objective: Enter the secret passage under the square

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Root... Root...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're finally here! Whoa, that's a whole load of funky stuff. Paimon doesn't see anyone around, but she's getting a familiar feeling... Evil's gotta be lurking nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Willow... Root...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are these the roots of that great tree from earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon gets it now! That's why the great tree looked so sickly. The roots have been corrupted!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Root... Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's clean up all this filth. Paimon reckons they're corrupting the roots.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is tough. This pollution's impossible to clear up!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, ka-pow!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Pahsiv touches your stomach with her hand, and you feel a warmth coming from her palm.\nYou feel like something in you has been enhanced.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, tired...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What did Pahsiv do? You look revitalized, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally, it's all gone. Paimon didn't know that you had such a marvelous ability, Pahsiv...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now... Wait... Something's lit up on the ground... It's some kinda arcane formation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh! Rifthounds are charging out!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Pahsiv. We'll protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Where are you going, Pahsiv? Stop! This place is dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Phew! Finally, that's that under control. We sure kicked the Rifthound nest, huh? {NICKNAME}, how are you doing?

choices.text: I can do this all day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's sure that wasn't just you boasting. It looks like the roots are recovering — guess that means the problem here has been cleared up, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what happened just then? A vishap turned up to help, and Pahsiv disappeared...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Pahsiv! Are you there? Can you hear Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, looks like she's really disappeared.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: She's got plenty of secrets, for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... She's such a mysterious Melusine. Paimon knows she didn't want any reward, but it still seems odd to just leave like that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's as if... It's as if you had a favorite food, and then one day, the food looks at you and says "guess we're through."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it's the same kind of feeling, y'know? But what if Pahsiv was injured? She seemed exhausted...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe we can look for her nearby.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes! Paimon thinks we should do that. Just in case she might be in danger, and all!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Just as you are about to look for Pahsiv, water floods into the cave, sweeping you toward the surface.

choices.text: Although talking food seems even odder.
My hands are just a bit sore.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Key, statue, key, statue, key, statue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! We didn't get a chance to look for her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'm sure she can swim.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true, but... Whoa! Look at the great tree!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's recovered, and it's so pretty! Is that what it looked like before? Pahsiv will be happy if she sees it, won't she?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon! Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv? Great! Where did you go? We were so worried!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Disappeared, Pahsiv.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Ah... Box. Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Is that a treasure chest? You went looking for treasure chests?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! But, shiny, round, Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You didn't find any Mora? That's fine. The chest is more than enough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You remembered what Paimon told you! Oh, you're gonna make Paimon cry! Thank you, Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Thank... you...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It means Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, thank you! {NICKNAME}, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, good thing! {NICKNAME}, good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, we should come to see Pahsiv often when we have time, and teach her more words, like New Valet did.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you think, Pahsiv? Can we come back to play with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where did she go this time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, disappeared!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Paimon has never seen a Melusine like her. Or rather... She doesn't behave like a Melusine, but more like a wild fairy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe that's why she can spy on the purple thing quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Pahsiv! Goodbye! If we meet again, we'll teach you how to say goodbye properly!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Root, very far ahead, very deep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we will keep going!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, what else do you know about the purple thing?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, very scary. Pahsiv, go near, scared...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, blue thing, fight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The blue thing... A vishap, perhaps? A vishap was fighting the purple thing?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! But... purple thing, very scary. Blue thing, lost lots of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But don't worry, {NICKNAME} is very powerful, too! {NICKNAME}'s taken down just about everything before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lost? Oh... Um, sorry...
